rules.title: Unqualified Guarantees & Absolute Claims
rules.rule_text: Never publish unverified absolute claims like '100% risk-free', 'zero errors guaranteed', or 'no loss possible'. Legal requires qualification and safe-harbor disclosures.
rules.rationale: Protects against regulatory penalties and consumer deception lawsuits.

rules.title: Current Pricing Standard & Legacy Rates
rules.rule_text: Standard Starter tier is $49/month billed annually. Enterprise tiers require tailored quotation. References to outdated promotional pricing (such as $29/mo) are strictly prohibited.
rules.rationale: Prevents pricing discrepancy, customer churn, and contract disputes.

rules.title: Unsubstantiated Superlatives & Puffery
rules.rule_text: Avoid superlative hype like 'world's greatest', 'unrivaled by all', or 'best in history'. Frame value propositions objectively around measurable user outcomes.
rules.rationale: Preserves our brand identity as an authoritative, trusted partner.

rules.title: High-Pressure FOMO & Aggressive Sales Language
rules.rule_text: Avoid aggressive panic-inducing CTAs like 'Act immediately before it's gone forever!' or 'Don't be left behind!'. Use confident, consultative invitations such as 'Schedule a demo today'.
rules.rationale: Empathetic, transparent brand voice builds long-term enterprise trust.

rules.title: Forward-Looking Roadmap & Security Disclaimers
rules.rule_text: All public mentions of security certifications must reflect SOC2 Type II (not SOC1) and GDPR compliance. Any future roadmaps must state 'Features subject to development timeline'.
rules.rationale: Ensures factual enterprise credibility during customer procurement.

rules.title: Visual Contrast & Accessibility Inclusivity
rules.rule_text: All visual banners and UI elements must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast). Provide descriptive alt text for all campaign visuals.
rules.rationale: Guarantees digital accessibility across all customer demographics.
